requirements.text: 2.5 Design and Implementation Constraints PDFsam is platform independent and is written in Java. Its user interface is written with Java Swing, so anyone who wishes to work on further development of PDFsam has to know this programming language. PDFsam is GNU GPLv2 licensed and the PDFsam-console is dual licensed (GPLv2 and LGPLv2). Everyone, that does or is going to develop or use PDFsam, should agree and fully accept the terms of this kind of license.
